title: Monthly MIS Reports and Live Dashboards
summary: A one-page MIS by the 7th, KPIs, variance commentary and a live dashboard that opens on any phone.
metaTitle: Monthly MIS Reports and Live Finance Dashboards
metaDescription: Monthly MIS reports and live dashboards for owners and boards: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPIs and variance commentary delivered by the 7th on WhatsApp.
heroIntro: The numbers you actually manage the business with: a one-page summary and a live dashboard, delivered by the 7th every month.
overview: A management information system (MIS) report should answer three questions quickly: how did we do, where did cash go, and what needs attention. We prepare yours from reconciled books, add commentary in plain language and send a PDF and dashboard link on WhatsApp by the 7th.
whatWeDo: Prepare the monthly profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow with commentary.
Track KPIs such as gross margin, receivable days and cash runway.
Analyse performance by department, branch, project or business unit.
Produce variance reports against budget, forecast or prior periods.
Build a live dashboard that summarises the key numbers in one view.
Send a one-page PDF summary on WhatsApp by the 7th every month.

byPlan.foundation: Standard one-page MIS and live dashboard.
byPlan.growth: Custom KPIs, department views and variance commentary.
byPlan.cfo: Forecast-linked MIS with scenarios and board-ready packs.

note: Dashboards are built in Looker Studio, so a link opens on any phone or laptop.

faqs.q: When do I receive the MIS?
faqs.a: By the 7th of the following month, with a PDF summary and a dashboard link sent on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can the MIS show departments or projects?
faqs.a: Yes, on Growth and CFO. You can also add department, branch, product or project-level packs as an add-on module.
